Corollary
[Bounds on $f$ for GRS (Corollary 27.10)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0031 ↗ thm:chow-iv-gradient-potential-bounds 1. ch27:27.10\group Potential estimates

For a normalized complete GRS and base point $\widetilde O$, \begin{align*} \varepsilon =0:& \quad |f(x)-f(\widetilde O)|\le d(x,\widetilde O),\\ \varepsilon =-1:& \quad f(x)\le \tfrac 14(d(x,\widetilde O)+2\sqrt{f(\widetilde O)})^2,\\ \varepsilon =1:& \quad -\tfrac 14(d(x,\widetilde O)+\sqrt{-4f(\widetilde O)+2n})^2+\tfrac n2 \le f(x)\le \tfrac n2. \end{align*} For a shrinker minimum point $O$, $f(O)\le n/2$ and $f(x)\le \frac14(d(x,O)+\sqrt{2n})^2$.
